recordedProductIssues: Opening frames reuse the review screen with tiny lock icons and bars overlapping labels

defects.problem: Section revisits previous visuals (review screen, dimmed highlight inset, unredacted screen) in quick succession, so each beat is short and the sequence feels like a recap montage
defects.fix: Hold each recap frame longer or remove one so the beats do not blur

defects.problem: The end card is a plain white box on a lilac field with an off-centre caption at the bottom left that does not align with the card's centred content
defects.fix: Centre the caption under the card or align the card's content left

defects.problem: Long hold on a static end card; the yellow wordmark block pops in after the mid frame, so the card reads as unfinished at the middle
defects.fix: Have the yellow block appear before the URLs and shorten the end hold

defects.problem: The ShowMe wordmark is large but the URLs are only plain text; no mark or distinctive element
defects.fix: Add a restrained accent to the URL line

couldNotAssess: Fade timing into the end card
oneLineVerdict: Clear, readable close with all links present; generic and static as an ending.
